citations.title: Rio Tinto: Solid results underpinned by +8% CuEq production and sharper cost discipline

sentences.text: Simon Trott, a Rio Tinto veteran of 25 years who led the iron ore division, became chief executive in August 2025 and reorganised the group into three divisions, Iron Ore, Aluminium and Lithium, and Copper, to simplify management and accountability.

sentences.quote:
Oyu Tolgoi copper underground development project now complete
Simandou high grade iron ore first ore shipment in December
Western Range iron ore replacement mine opened on time and on budget
sentences.text: Execution milestones in 2025 included completing the Oyu Tolgoi underground project, first Simandou ore shipment and the Western Range replacement mine delivered on time and on budget.

On capital allocation, the $6.5bn ordinary dividend marked a tenth year at a 60% payout, while net debt rose to $14.4bn and a $5-10bn capital release programme was launched, with over $2bn secured by the third quarter of 2026.
